findings.quote: While AI holds great promise for economic development, it also carries the risk that must be carefully managed. The inclusive and constructive dialogue that shaped this resolution offers a model for future discussions including those on peace, security, and the responsible military use of AI.
findings.rationale: Supports UN-led inclusive AI dialogue, economic opportunities, risk management, safe trustworthy systems and responsible military use; notes co-sponsorship of the first UN AI resolution.
